title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 18-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base Allied Brass
description:
Add refined countertop storage with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass with an 18-inch height and a weighted base for stability. Designed to keep a roll close at hand without wall mounting, it complements traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories styling while working beautifully in kitchens and utility spaces.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting
- Crafted from the finest solid brass materials
- Solid brass weighted base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect countertops and other surfaces from scratches
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free, rust-free performance

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Overall size: 5.5 in L x 5.5 in W x 18 in H
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
